## What Digital Ninja Technologies Does

Digital Ninja Technologies designs and builds digital products for founders, startups, SMEs, and global enterprises. The agency operates across web design, mobile app development, custom software, brand identity, UI/UX design, game development, and MVP development.

The team works with clients across Africa, Europe, North America, and the Middle East. Projects range from pre-launch waitlist sites for early-stage startups to full-scale SaaS platforms and mobile applications.

Key differentiators:
- Design and development under one roof — no handoffs between separate teams
- Fixed timelines and transparent pricing with no hidden costs
- Post-launch support included on every project
- Direct communication with the team building the product

## Services in Detail

### Web Design & Development
Websites and web platforms built with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Services include landing pages, business websites, e-commerce, web applications, and SaaS platforms. Focus on conversion rate optimisation, mobile performance, and SEO foundations.

### Mobile App Development
Cross-platform iOS and Android applications built with Flutter. The team handles UI/UX design, development, testing, App Store and Play Store submission, and post-launch support.

### Custom Software Development
Backend systems, APIs, dashboards, admin tools, and SaaS platforms built with Node.js, PostgreSQL, and cloud infrastructure. Includes third-party integrations and scalable architecture design.

### Brand Identity
Complete visual identity systems including logo design, colour systems, typography, brand guidelines, and design system creation. Work spans early-stage startups through to established brands refreshing their identity.

### UI/UX Design
User research, information architecture, wireframing, interactive prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design for web and mobile products. Design is strategy-led and conversion-focused.

### Game Development
Cross-platform games built with Unity, Godot, WebGL, and Three.js. Services include game UI design, mechanics design, and full game development.

### MVP Development
Fastest path from validated idea to a live, testable product. Includes product scoping, design, development, and launch support. Typically 4 to 12 weeks depending on complexity.

## Portfolio

### Veritas (2026)
Cross-border escrow payment app for freelancers. Digital Ninja Technologies designed and built the waitlist landing page and mobile app UI. The app holds payments in escrow and settles in local currencies across NGN, GHS, KES, ZAR, and USD.
- Live: https://www.useveritasapp.com
- Case study: https://www.thedigitalninjatech.com/works/veritas

### Brandface (2026)
Lead conversion landing page for a legal marketing agency specialising in personal injury law firms. The page promised 20 to 30 qualified consultations in the first 90 days.
- Live: https://brandface-eta.vercel.app
- Case study: https://www.thedigitalninjatech.com/works/brandface

### Moducode (2026)
UI/UX design for a B2B SaaS talent platform connecting global companies with engineers from emerging markets. Designed to reduce hiring friction and increase consultation bookings.
- Live: https://krevops.com
- Case study: https://www.thedigitalninjatech.com/works/moducode

### Korlod Works (2025)
Full website design and development for a creative agency covering brand identity, web solutions, digital marketing, and content strategy.
- Live: https://korlodworks.com
- Case study: https://www.thedigitalninjatech.com/works/korlodworks
